# artifactory_virtual_nvidia_nim_repository (Resource)

Creates a virtual NVIDIA NIM repository. Official documentation can be found [here](https://jfrog.com/help/r/jfrog-artifactory-documentation/nvidia-nim-repositories).

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "artifactory_virtual_nvidia_nim_repository" "nvidia-nim-virtual" {
  key = "nvidia-nim-virtual"
}
```

## Import

```sh
terraform import artifactory_virtual_nvidia_nim_repository.nvidia-nim-virtual nvidia-nim-virtual
```
